usedFor: A “New Filing” in beatandraise opens a deal in HubSpot so sales sees the signal.

bestTemplate.name: “New Filing” in beatandraise, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: You can filter by company, form type or 8-K item, so only real signals create deals.

watchOut: Both triggers run daily, so a filing can reach HubSpot a day late; filter by form type.
